changeSet.sql: create table integration_mail ( id int not null default 1 constraint integration_mail_pk primary key constraint integration_mail_id_ck check (id = 1), host text not null constraint integration_mail_host_ck check (char_length(host) between 1 and 253), port int not null constraint integration_mail_port_ck check (port between 1 and 65535), benutzer text not null constraint integration_mail_benutzer_ck check (char_length(benutzer) between 1 and 320), passwort_verschluesselt bytea not null, zugelassene_absender text[] not null default '{}', aktiv boolean not null default true, fehler_in_folge int not null default 0 constraint integration_mail_fehler_ck check (fehler_in_folge >= 0), geaendert timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp() )
